notes: NHRA source: nhra_corvette-1953-1982.json (starts 1955). GM Heritage Corvette kits for every year 1953-1982 were OCR'd (vette/k/); from the mid-1950s on most kits include reprinted Corvette Black Book (Michael Bruce Associates) pages with suffix codes, option lists and VIN engine codes, cited here as part of the GM kit (one manufacturer source). Independent sources: Wikipedia (C1/C2/C3 and small-/big-block articles, counted once), CorvSport.com year spec pages (powertrain tables and engine suffix lists; its suffix lists track the Black Book, so CorvSport is not fully independent of the kit pages), Corvette Action Center spec pages (C1, 1963, 1965, 1969 RPO list, 1974-1981; 1964/1966-68/1970-73/1982 pages unavailable or image-only). EPA file is empty (pre-1984). HP: SAE gross 1953-1971 (1971 net figures in note), SAE net 1972-1982. California ratings are noted on the federal entry except the 1980 California-only 305.
